title: Limitation of actions.
bodyText: Any action to enforce a cause of action arising under this chapter shall be barred unless commenced within four years after the cause of action accrues. For the purposes of this section, a cause of action for a continuing violation is deemed to accrue at any time during the period of the violation.
bodyHtml: [§481N-5]  Limitation of actions.  Any action to enforce a cause of action arising under this chapter shall be barred unless commenced within four years after the cause of action accrues.  For the purposes of this section, a cause of action for a continuing violation is deemed to accrue at any time during the period of the violation. [L 2025, c 143, pt of §2]
